BCX2"gtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtThus, in line with fifth SHF Reserve Allocation for 2023 and in support of the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan (EPRP), Acted proposes Through this, lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtActedlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt will target 5 IDP sites and 5 host community and rural villages in low laying, previously flood-affected riverine areas in lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtBaadheerelt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt, Gedo in line with the location priorities provided in the allocation strategy. ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtActedlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt will (1) help meet immediate food needs through the provision of three cycles of unconditional cash transfers to 1,425 HHs, thus reaching an estimated number of 8550 people. Per cycle, each HH will receive 80 USD in line with Cash Working Group recommendations. Selection of HHs will be guided by vulnerability criteria and facilitated by Village Relief Committees and Community Mobilization Committees, thus localizing the response. To understand beneficiary perceptions of the activity and to inform future programming, post-distribution monitoring will be conducted after the first and the third cycle. Furthermore, lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtActedlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt will (2) enhance access of beneficiaries to life-saving flood-related information through the establishment and capacitation of flood response committees in all sites, which will be trained to support their communities’ flood preparedness and response. As part of a two-way alert system, these committees will share bottom-up information on the situation on the ground with Acted project staff. Community outreach workers will complement their work through further sensitization sessions, together with social media and radio messaging aiming to maximize outreach leaving no one behind. To further increase the efficiency and effectiveness of these actions, lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtActedlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt will (3) support the cluster coordination efforts by facilitating humanitarian-institutional taskforce catch-up meetings in Baardheere and will organize further coordination efforts on an ad-hoc basis. lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun AdvancedProofingIssueV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtTaking into accountlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt the specific needs of vulnerable groups, lt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun ContextualSpellingAndGrammarErrorV2Themed SCXW156602078 BCX2"gtActedlt/spangtltspan class="NormalTextRun SCXW156602078 BCX2"gt will fulfil protection, gender and disability mainstreaming considerations throughout the full project cycle.lt/spangtlt/spangtltspan class="EOP SCXW156602078 BCX2" style="line-height: 14.0292px font-family: Arial," data-ccp-props="{"gt lt/spangtlt/pgtlt/divgtlt/divgt
